items.ref: Tona ya Pusotshwaraganelo le Merero ya Setso (CoGTA), Ngk Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma o ne a tsenetse moletlo o wa semmuso wa go fetola leina la Mbizana go nna Mmasepala wa selegae wa Winnie Madikizela-Mandela.

items.hyp: Mmueledi wa kwa mokgatlho wa winna, Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Daniswa Mafumbatha a re go na le diporofaele tse di tlhagisitsweng go netefatsa gore batho ba le mo mokgatlho ba tshwanetse go nna le porojeke e e tlhagisitsweng.
items.ref: Mmeyara wa Masepala o montšha o o tswang go kaiwa ka leina le le ntšha la Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Daniswa  Mafumbatha o rile, go na le mananeo a rulagantsweng go netefatsa gore batho ba lefelo le ba ungwa sengwe  go tswa mo segakeng sa tokologo.

items.hyp: Mafumbatha o dumela gore go tlhoka mmasepala le go tlhoka batho ba ba tlhophilweng.
items.ref: Mafumbatha o dumela gore go fetola leina la mmasepala go tla ngokela babeeletsi go feta.

items.hyp: Mme Winnie Madikizela Mandela a ikonomi ya ngwaga o tlaa nna le go tlhagelela morago ga go tlaa tshwara tiragalo e e tshwanang le e le gore re le gore re le gore re a tlhagisitse tiro ya rona ya ga mama.
items.ref: Winnie Madikizela-Mandela o ne a le mogaka wa boditšhabatšhaba jaanong go reela mmasepala ka leina la gagwe go tlile go dira gore tlhabololo ya rona e gole ka bonako, mme gape re bua ka boswa jwa Mme Winnie.

items.hyp: Mokaedi wa dikgoka wa bofelo kwa kokoong ya Frere kwa Kapa Bophirima, Dr David Stead, o tlhagisitse matshwenyego a gore go tswa kwa ntle ga go dira ditshwetso tsa bofelo kwa ntlong ya kwa godimo ya Rreding, e tlaa tshwanelwa ke go dira ditshwetso tsa bofelo tse di neng di tshwanetse go fitlhelela meento ya coronavirus mo bekeng e e fetileng.
items.ref: Moitseanape wa malwetse a a tshelanang kwa Bookelong jwa Frere kwa Kapa Botlhaba, Ngk David Stead,  o tlhagisitse matshwenyego a gore tsweletso ya go nwa notagi kwa mafelong ka nako ya maikhutso a paseka a beke e telele a ka oketsa  ditshwaetso  tsa Khorona mo dibekeng tse di tlang.

items.hyp: Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa mo bekeng e e fetileng o begile gore go tlhoka dikgoka tsa bofelo ya go tswa kwa dikagong tse di fetileng go tlhoka mo dikagong, dikagong tse di fetileng, mme bofelo jwa bo neng bo tlaa tshwara kwa dikagong go tswa kwa dikgalemogong.
